_purpose: Committed authorization policy for the Step-452 Stage-2 package. The runtime gate reads this from HEAD (not from .git/config) and requires the sole key in the committed allowed-signers file to match authorized_fingerprint before it will accept any sanction tag.
rule: Exactly one authorized key. Signature verification is performed with an allowed-signers file containing ONLY this key, materialized from the committed HEAD blob; a tag that verifies under that anchor necessarily came from the authorized key.
